versions.changelog:
Initial release of the animation-shader skill.

- Provides a comprehensive reference for implementing and configuring animation-style shaders, including toon/cel shading, outlines, rim lighting, MatCap, emission, dissolve, hatching, and stylized effects.
- Includes ready-to-use preset styles and use cases for different visual goals (e.g., Basic Anime, Advanced Illustration, Cyber/VFX, Oil Painting).
- Supplies detailed feature lists with mappings to reference files for popular Unity shaders (lilToon, Poiyomi, UTS2, RToon, SToon, ToonShadingCollection).
- Designed to be used as a domain knowledge plugin alongside workflow skills or agents for structured shader design.
- Provides standalone guidance for shader design if workflow skills are not present.
